editorNote: Gold and bitcoin both extended losses on rate worries, Anthropic's IPO filing put numbers on Alphabet's exposure, and Rocket Lab and Alibaba traded on contract and earnings news. Headlines only; this is not investment advice.

stories.headline: Gold opens at its lowest price since Sept. 29, 2025, Yahoo Finance says; Kitco has it at $3,848 after retail sales
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's Nov. 17 gold report says bullion opened at its lowest since Sept. 29, 2025. Kitco's headline puts gold at $3,848 an ounce after October retail sales rose 0.2% and core sales rose 0.6%.
stories.whyItMatters: Yesterday's slide has extended to a 13-month low, with a US data release cited as the latest trigger.

sourceLinks.title: Gold price today, Nov. 17, 2026 - Yahoo Finance
Gold price drops to $3,848/oz after October retail sales - Kitco

stories.headline: Bitcoin hovers below $65,000 as rate fears and ETF outflows weigh, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's headline says bitcoin is trading below $65,000, with rate fears and ETF outflows weighing on the market.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin has stayed under pressure after Sunday's drop to a three-month low near $62,000, with outflows and rate expectations cited as the drags.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Hovers Below $65,000 as Rate Fears, ETF Outflows Weigh on Market - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing shows Amazon and Google will own about 28% of its stock
stories.summary: Bloomberg and Quartz headlines say Anthropic's IPO filing shows Amazon and Google together will hold about 28% of its stock after the offering.
stories.whyItMatters: The filing discloses how large Alphabet's stake-linked exposure to Anthropic will be at listing.

sourceLinks.title: Amazon, Google to Have About 28% of Anthropic Stock After IPO - Bloomberg
Anthropic's IPO filing shows Amazon and Google will own about 28% of its stock - Quartz

stories.headline: Rocket Lab slides 4% as SpaceX shares a $985 million launch award, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance reports Rocket Lab shares slid 4% as SpaceX shared in a $985 million launch award; the article also looks at Cathie Wood's and David Tepper's positions.
stories.whyItMatters: A large launch award went partly to a competitor, and Rocket Lab's stock fell on the day.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Slides 4% as SpaceX Shares a $985 Million Launch Award - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Alibaba nears a two-year low ahead of earnings, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance says Alibaba shares are near a two-year low before earnings, noting Wall Street targets implying 104% upside and investor Michael Burry's attention on a rival AI company.
stories.whyItMatters: Alibaba heads into its Q2 results with its shares near multi-year lows; the earnings date was previously reported as Nov. 19.

sourceLinks.title: BABA Nears 2-Year Low Before Earnings - Yahoo Finance
Alibaba Q2 Earnings Preview - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Anchorage and Kalshi Prime let institutions use custodied bitcoin as margin, The Block reports
stories.summary: The Block reports that Anchorage and Kalshi Prime will let institutions post bitcoin held in custody as margin.
stories.whyItMatters: Custodied bitcoin can now serve as collateral on an institutional prediction-market venue.

sourceLinks.title: Anchorage, Kalshi Prime let institutions use custodied bitcoin as margin - The Block

stories.headline: Russia opens retail bitcoin buying, but banks aren't ready, Bitcoin Magazine says
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine's headline says Russia has opened retail bitcoin buying, while banks are not yet ready to support it.
stories.whyItMatters: A retail channel has opened on paper before the banking infrastructure behind it is in place.

sourceLinks.title: Russia Opens Retail Bitcoin Buying, But Banks Aren't Ready - Bitcoin Magazine
